command: set -e; SERIAL=RFCT70L7E8J; APK=$(cat /tmp/phase1c_apk_path); cleanup(){ python3 scripts/s22_call_control.py --serial "$SERIAL" hangup >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; }; trap cleanup EXIT; echo '=== SILENT PCM DTMF 1 CALL_ASSISTANT ==='; adb -s "$SERIAL" logcat -c; python3 scripts/s22_call_control.py --serial "$SERIAL" dial 510100100; OFF=0; for i in $(seq 1 50); do ST=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys telephony.registry | sed -n 's/.*mCallState=\([0-9][0-9]*\).*/\1/p' | head -n1); echo pcm_call_state=$ST; [ "$ST" = "2" ] && OFF=1 && break; sleep 0.4; done; test "$OFF" = "1"; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell cmd audio adj-mute 0; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell cmd audio adj-mute 8; V=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys audio | grep -i -A6 -B1 'STREAM_VOICE_CALL' | head -n 10); printf '%s\n' "$V" | grep -q 'Muted: true'; sleep 6.0; test "$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys telephony.registry | sed -n 's/.*mCallState=\([0-9][0-9]*\).*/\1/p' | head -n1)" = "2"; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell "CLASSPATH=$APK app_process /system/bin pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge.CallAssistantAudioProbe play-dual-tone 16000 300 697 1209 0.10"; sleep 0.8; test "$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys telephony.registry | sed -n 's/.*mCallState=\([0-9][0-9]*\).*/\1/p' | head -n1)" = "2"; python3 scripts/s22_call_control.py --serial "$SERIAL" capture 3000 /tmp/phase1c_pcm.wav; echo '=== FOCUSED TX LOGCAT ==='; adb -s "$SERIAL" logcat -d -v brief | grep -i -E 'CALL_ASSISTANT|incall_music|TELEPHONY_TX|getOutputForAttr|AudioTrack' | tail -n 180 || true; python3 scripts/s22_call_control.py --serial "$SERIAL" hangup; trap - EXIT; sleep 0.8; test "$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys telephony.registry | sed -n 's/.*mCallState=\([0-9][0-9]*\).*/\1/p' | head -n1)" = "0"; test -s /tmp/phase1c_pcm.wav; echo silent_pcm_capture=true
